transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because... I just feel completely flat inside. It doesn't matter what's going on around me. Even when my children come over to sit with me, or when the sun is shining right on my garden—things that usually make me happy—I just don't feel anything good. It's like the part of me that could feel glad or comforted just shut off completely.
Have you had another period like this in the past?

No, I haven't. I mean, at my age, you certainly go through your share of hard times and sad days, but... no. I've never had a time where I just felt absolutely nothing at all like this. This is the first time.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people do not?
No, nothing like that. I haven't seen or heard anything that isn't really there. My mind is clear in that way, just... empty.
Have you had thoughts that life is not worth living?

No, I haven't. I don't want to die or anything like that. I know I said I feel empty, but... well, I haven't had any thoughts about life not being worth living. I just wish I could feel the good parts of it again.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably more slowly than usual?
No, I don't think so. I mean, at my age, I don't exactly rush around anyway, but... no, I haven't noticed myself moving or talking any slower than my usual.
Have you lost your appetite?
No, my appetite has been fine. I still eat my regular meals every day, just like always. I haven't noticed any changes with that.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the day?
No, I wouldn't say I've been feeling sad or down. I'm not sitting around crying or anything like that. Like I mentioned earlier, it's more just... an empty feeling. But no, I haven't really felt sad.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low in energy?

No, not unusually tired. I have about the same amount of energy I normally do. I mean, at my age I get a bit worn out by the end of the day, but it hasn't been any worse than usual. I don't feel drained or anything out of the ordinary.
Have you lost interest in the things you usually enjoy doing?
No, I still like doing my usual things. I still tend to my garden a bit in the mornings, and I watch my programs in the evening. I haven't lost interest in any of that.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yes, actually, I have. I used to... well, I used to plan all my own meals and keep my calendar straight without any trouble. But lately, I just stare at a grocery list or the schedule for the senior center, and my mind just goes completely blank. My daughter has had to start helping me decide on even the most simple things because I just can't seem to focus on it.
Have you been feeling worthless?

No, I haven't felt that way. I mean, it's a little frustrating having to rely on my daughter so much lately for things I used to do myself, but... I don't feel worthless. I know I still matter to my family, so no, I wouldn't say I've been feeling like that.
Have you been sleeping more or less than usual lately?
No, my sleep hasn't really changed. I still go to bed around the same time and wake up when I usually do. I haven't noticed sleeping any more or less than I normally would.
How long have you been feeling this empty inside?
Well, this has been going on for about two weeks now. It started right after my husband collapsed... ever since the paramedics were in our kitchen working on him, I've just felt this way.
